notice: AI-assisted adversarial engineering review. This is not human scientific approval, production approval, or evidence of predictive validity.

rules.selectionRationale: Local tidal-Potomac feeding evidence, hourly solar input, exact May-June and tidal-water gates, and reduced minor magnitude.
rules.validationScope: Prospective targeted trips in tidal Potomac or comparable connected tidal reaches during May-June, stratified across morning, daylight, and overnight periods.

rules.selectionRationale: Direct compulsory-creel catchability endpoint, hourly solar input, simple nonstacking light representation, and conservative bounded uplift.
rules.validationScope: Prospective targeted trips on documented NOVA or upper-Potomac lake/reservoir walleye waters, stratified across dawn, day, and dusk.

observationContract.unitOfAnalysis: one completed targeted angling trip for one species and one continuous fishing interval
requiredPractices: Record zero-catch trips rather than collecting catches only.
Lock the model version, fixture hash, and analysis plan before a trip can enter confirmatory evaluation.
Record the actual named spot and start/end time supplied by the angler; do not freeze a forecast in the trip-entry flow.
Reconstruct environmental inputs from independently archived, time-indexed sources without using the catch outcome.
Keep targeted and incidental catches separate.
Exclude exact private coordinates from public outputs.
Never scrape or republish restricted third-party catch reports.
Keep ordinary private trip logs in the calibration store; never copy them automatically into the formal validation-observation store.

validationStages.purpose: Verify ranges, interpolation, gates, caps, missing inputs, and nonstacking behavior.
Collect effort-aware targeted trips, including explicit zero-catch trips, against a locked model version; environmental inputs are replayed from independent historical sources.
Compare candidate-v0.2.0 against the current score on waterbody and time holdouts.
A named human reviewer accepts sources, curves, metrics, uncertainty, and release scope.
